title: Zehra s.a ke haath me
body:
Zehra s.a ke haath me
Sayeda, Tahera..(8)
<<DIVIDER>>
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra ke hath me..(2)
sher e khuda ka haath hai Zehra  ke hath me
<<DIVIDER>>
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
1. Allah ne mangali sare arsh rotiyan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
koi to aaisi baat hai Zehra  ke hath me
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jis dar se chal raha hai Zamane ka har nizam..(2)
us ki ma'ashiat hai Zehra  ke hath me
<<DIVIDER>>
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
3. Beti ko sath laae hai is waste rasool..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
najraniyon ki maat hai Zehra  ke hath me
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Malik hai jaise chahe yeh tabdiliyan kare..(2)
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kehne lage hussain yeh rumaal band kar..(2)
jaa hur teri najaat hai Zehra  ke hath me
<<DIVIDER>>
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
6.Hathon me hath shabbar o shabbir  ke nahi..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
islam ki hayaat hai Zehra  ke hath me
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kaise mitae koi aza ki nishaniyan ..(2)
hifz e tabarrukat hai Zehra  ke hath me
<<DIVIDER>>
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
8. Tasbihe fatema  ne takallum bata diya
<<DIVIDER>>
har radd e mushkilat hai Zehra  ke hath me
kul nazm e qaiyanat hai Zehra  ke hath me..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
sayeda, tahera ..(2)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
